description_json.name: Vigenere Cipher with Fixed Key
description_json.idea: A polyalphabetic substitution cipher using a fixed repeating keyword 'SAFE'. The shift value changes for each letter based on the corresponding letter of the keyword. Non-alphabetic characters remain unchanged.
description_json.encrypt_rules: For each character in the plaintext: 1. If it is an alphabetic letter, determine its 0-based index (A=0, B=1, ..., Z=25), preserving case. 2. Determine the shift value from the repeating keyword 'SAFE' (S=18, A=0, F=5, E=4). The keyword index advances only when an alphabetic letter is encrypted. 3. Calculate the encrypted letter: Cipher_Index = (Plain_Index + Shift_Index) % 26. 4. If the character is not an alphabetic letter, leave it unchanged and do not advance the keyword index.
description_json.decrypt_rules: For each character in the ciphertext: 1. If it is an alphabetic letter, determine its 0-based index (A=0, B=1, ..., Z=25), preserving case. 2. Determine the shift value from the repeating keyword 'SAFE' (S=18, A=0, F=5, E=4). The keyword index advances only when an alphabetic letter is decrypted. 3. Calculate the decrypted letter: Plain_Index = (Cipher_Index - Shift_Index + 26) % 26. 4. If the character is not an alphabetic letter, leave it unchanged and do not advance the keyword index.

description_json.name: QWERTY monoalphabetic substitution cipher
description_json.idea: A fixed one-to-one substitution over the English alphabet. Each plaintext letter is replaced by exactly one ciphertext letter using a single bijection, and the mapping is the same for uppercase and lowercase letters. Non-letter characters are left unchanged.
description_json.encrypt_rules: Use the following bijection: plaintext alphabet abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz -> ciphertext alphabet qwertyuiopasdfghjklzxcvbnm. Thus a->q, b->w, c->e, d->r, e->t, f->y, g->u, h->i, i->o, j->p, k->a, l->s, m->d, n->f, o->g, p->h, q->j, r->k, s->l, t->z, u->x, v->c, w->v, x->b, y->n, z->m. Uppercase letters use the same mapping, preserving case. All non-letter characters remain unchanged.
description_json.decrypt_rules: Use the inverse bijection: ciphertext alphabet qwertyuiopasdfghjklzxcvbnm -> plaintext alphabet abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz. Thus q->a, w->b, e->c, r->d, t->e, y->f, u->g, i->h, o->i, p->j, a->k, s->l, d->m, f->n, g->o, h->p, j->q, k->r, l->s, z->t, x->u, c->v, v->w, b->x, n->y, m->z. Uppercase letters use the same mapping, preserving case. All non-letter characters remain unchanged.
